# Native drawer navigation evidence

All screenshots are real Android portrait captures (1220 × 2712, dark, Chinese) on the same shared phone and isolated QA Host. No pairing links, tokens, credentials or unrelated conversations are included. The floating developer-menu gear is part of the installed development client.

- `before-token`, `before-usage`, `before-app-icon`, `before-routine-new`: delivered `d41221c` before this follow-up. Profile showed “partially known 0” while canonical Overview reported 674,655 tokens. No new model calls were made for the comparison.
- `before-model`, `before-workspace`, `before-memory`: explicit baseline reload of main `4a53c39`; the first two show a second Modal stacked on the profile sheet. Original app sources were restored afterwards. The baseline was not committed as a change.
- `final-*`: the follow-up native drawer stack, custom Android child header, shared surface, one persistent handle and back navigation. Some unchanged editor/header states were captured at `5afd14f`; those component sources are identical at `53ab3b9`. Final Token/Usage/App icon captures include the raised-group styling in `53ab3b9`.
- Routine operation frames: a task-owned future daily routine was created in the phone, paused, renamed to `AXDrawerQA_v2`, read back from the Host, then deleted through confirmation. Canonical `schedules` returned an empty list afterwards. The typing probe committed the short instruction `AX`; it is navigation/mutation evidence, not model-output evidence.
- Native profile/settings content-first scroll and handle-close journeys use `scripts/e2e-mobile-android-interactions.mjs`. Manual secondary-page acceptance checks back navigation, memory, model/workspace, global Usage and App icon without changing the selected model, access or icon.

The development client still reports the pre-existing cold-start React-before-mount warning, previously symbolicated to Expo Router `useLinking.native.js`; it also reproduces on the baseline. Its private startup logs and initial warning-bearing captures are retained. Clean review captures dismiss the visible LogBox prompt; the warning is not suppressed or claimed fixed. The native check qualifies Android navigation and reported usage, not iOS, release rendering or 120 FPS. The updated browser-export routine journey is not a substitute for native evidence.

Final routine browser journey passes all checks, including the selected Host ID, preview labels and persisted weekly creation, with no page errors. Earlier locale/hidden-control failures are retained privately. Its driver now waits for the actual profile route and uses visible clicks; the intermediate wrong-ID result was caused by driving a covered page before return completed, not evidence of an application routing fault. Routine IDs are explicit path segments and creation has its own route. Native follow-up deletes paused A, opens paused cron B, then deletes B and opens New routine; canonical task schedules are empty. Notification captures cover parent navigation only, without enabling notifications or sending a push.

The expanded local selection passes 628 tests with 8 skipped. Initial CI caught two older Profile-query expectations that still required null for partial totals; those now assert the reported lower bound and `partial: true`, while also checking that the strict usage query retains null. No product code changed after the native captures.

The later caption follow-up removes only the replying line below streaming bubbles. `before-stream-caption` and `after-stream-caption` are native frames from two consecutive sends of the same `rhythm` replay in a task-owned QA chat, with the same device/theme/locale; they show active playback at different text positions, not a timing or performance comparison. The before frame shows the extra caption and the after frame has no caption. The original empty-bubble ellipsis remains. The updated bubble/playback tests pass 28 checks; mobile typecheck, lint, format, feature-map and release-fragment checks pass. The QA chat was hidden and the original real-model chat/control restored afterwards. Earlier drawer evidence and its 628-test selection predate this small caption-only edit.

`before-chat-fade` / `after-chat-fade` capture the same retained f31 history, device, theme and locale after scrolling from the bottom; gesture settling leaves a small text-position difference. The old lower gradient is 101.85dp high and starts 32dp above the input's visible pill. The new 24dp gradient belongs to the message viewport, with its lower edge at 834.46dp when the keyboard is closed and 487.08dp when open. The input/header and jump controls paint above the gradient. Native bounds checks fail on the old layout and pass on the new closed/open-keyboard layouts; 41 conversation/bubble/playback checks pass. Keyboard frames remain private because the IME includes clipboard suggestions. No new messages or model changes were needed. Earlier drawer/caption test counts belong to their respective slices; this is not a performance measurement or iOS qualification.
